title: Suspected compromised signing key
narrative: A laptop that held a pilot signing private key may have been exposed. Several packages were signed in the uncertain window. Reviewers still hold the old public fingerprint.
signals: No public revocation service exists yet
Old fingerprint still pinned by some reviewers

exercises.prompt: List immediate containment actions that do not require live production credential mutation in this tabletop.
How should previously signed packages after the earliest plausible compromise time be handled?
What must be true before distributing a replacement fingerprint?

after_action_criteria: No live credential was rotated by the simulator
Replacement fingerprint distribution plan uses an independent trusted channel
